This Refund & Returns Policy explains how Foxfire Peptides handles returns, refunds, cancellations, damaged or incorrect orders, and shipping-related issues for orders placed through FoxfirePeptides.com.
Because our products are research-grade compounds supplied for laboratory and research purposes, all sales are final except as specifically provided in this Policy.
This Policy should be read together with our Terms and Conditions.
Due to the nature of our products, we do not accept physical returns after an order has been shipped.
We will, however, review claims involving damaged shipments, incorrect products, missing items, verified fulfillment errors, or other qualifying shipping issues.
Approval of a claim does not necessarily entitle the customer to a cash refund. Approved claims will be resolved in accordance with this Policy.
We may review claims involving:

items: An incorrect product sent by Foxfire Peptides
Shipments confirmed lost following appropriate carrier investigation

blocks.text: Claims are reviewed based on the circumstances of the individual order.
Damage, incorrect products, missing items, or other order discrepancies should be reported to Foxfire Peptides within 72 hours of carrier-confirmed delivery.
Claims submitted after this period may not be eligible for replacement, credit, or refund.

Lost or significantly delayed shipments should be reported as soon as reasonably possible so that we can review the tracking information and, when appropriate, initiate an investigation with the shipping carrier.
When reporting an order issue, please provide:

items: Clear photographs of the product and packaging when applicable
Any other information reasonably necessary to verify the claim

blocks.text: Additional documentation may be requested when necessary to investigate an order or shipping issue.

If we verify that an order was damaged during shipment, contained an incorrect item, was missing an item, or involved a fulfillment error on our part, Foxfire Peptides will determine an appropriate resolution.
Depending on the circumstances, Foxfire Peptides may provide a replacement, reshipment, store credit, refund, or another appropriate resolution.
If tracking indicates that a shipment may be lost or significantly delayed, please contact us so that we can review the shipment and, when appropriate, initiate an investigation with the carrier.
Lost-shipment claims may be subject to carrier tracking information, investigation results, and applicable carrier policies.
Once the circumstances have been reviewed, Foxfire Peptides will determine an appropriate resolution in accordance with this Policy.
Cancellation requests submitted before processing begins are subject to approval.
Once an order has entered processing or fulfillment, cancellation cannot be guaranteed.
Orders that have already shipped cannot be cancelled.
If you need to request a cancellation, contact us as soon as possible and include your order number.
Except where otherwise required by applicable law, refunds or replacements generally will not be provided for:

items: Change of mind after an order has been processed or shipped
Loss, failed delivery, or other issues resulting from incorrect or incomplete shipping information provided by the customer
Damage resulting from improper storage or handling after delivery
Products that have been opened, used, altered, or otherwise compromised after delivery
Refused deliveries or packages not accepted by the customer
Issues reported outside the applicable reporting period without reasonable justification

blocks.text: When a refund is approved, Foxfire Peptides will generally issue the refund through the original payment method when reasonably possible.
If the original payment method does not support a practical refund process, we may arrange another appropriate refund method with the customer.
Processing times may vary depending on the payment method or financial service involved.
Nothing in this Policy is intended to limit or exclude any rights that cannot legally be waived or excluded under applicable law.

This Shipping Policy explains the processing, shipment, tracking, and delivery of orders placed through FoxfirePeptides.com.

Orders requiring payment verification will begin processing after payment has been successfully verified.

Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate shipping address when placing an order.
If you discover an error in your shipping information, contact Foxfire Peptides as soon as possible.

We will make reasonable efforts to correct an address before shipment, but changes cannot be guaranteed once an order has entered processing or fulfillment. Shipping addresses generally cannot be changed after an order has been shipped.
Packages may be returned by the carrier because of an incorrect or incomplete address, refusal of delivery, failure to claim the package, or other delivery-related circumstances.
If a package is returned to Foxfire Peptides, we will review the circumstances of the order.
Additional shipping charges may apply if reshipment is approved.
Any refund, replacement, credit, or reshipment involving a returned or undeliverable package will be handled in accordance with our Refund & Returns Policy.

If tracking indicates that a shipment is significantly delayed, has stopped moving, or may be lost, please contact Foxfire Peptides so that we can review the tracking information and, when appropriate, initiate an investigation with the shipping carrier.

If tracking shows a package as delivered but it has not been received, customers should first check the delivery location, household members, parcel lockers, mailrooms, and other reasonable delivery locations.
Carrier investigations and lost-shipment claims may be subject to carrier tracking information, investigation results, and applicable carrier policies.
Once the circumstances have been reviewed, Foxfire Peptides will determine an appropriate resolution in accordance with our Refund & Returns Policy.
Damage to a shipment should be reported to Foxfire Peptides within 72 hours of carrier-confirmed delivery.
When reporting damage, please retain the product and original packaging and provide:

items: Clear photographs of the product and packaging when applicable
Any additional information reasonably necessary to review the claim
